entity_types.name: bestial
entity_types.description: Entities driven by instinct, body strength, hunting patterns, and territorial reactions.

entity_types.name: arcane
entity_types.description: Entities shaped by unstable magic, spell-like instincts, and high mana pressure.

entity_types.name: undead
entity_types.description: Entities animated by death energy, lingering will, or corrupted remains.

entity_types.name: elemental
entity_types.description: Entities made from raw natural forces, often bound to a dominant element.

entity_types.name: construct
entity_types.description: Artificial or engineered entities built for endurance, obedience, and precise action.

entity_types.name: abberation
entity_types.description: Entities that defy natural laws, often with bizarre forms and unpredictable behaviors.
